Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School as Columbia Heights. The nearest station to Cleveland Elementary School (DCPS, 8th St NW) is Shaw–Howard University (or U Street) on the Green/Yellow, not Columbia Heights. This incorrect premise led to an incorrect station count and thus the wrong final answer.
